items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: We did a ... a fellow you might remember by the name of William Grant Still (Steele). ... INTERVIEWER: Him I didn't know. I met him in later years but Joe Jordan conducted the band out there and added to my respect of Joe Jordan.

ctx.x: I met Joe Jordan and I thanked him. I had a little trouble getting the card and I thanked him for that. Joe Jordan is a tremendous person. I think he died out in Oregon around six months ago. And he's around 89 years old. We did a ... a fellow you might remember by the name of William Grant Still (Steele). We did a ...
Wrote me a letter not long ago.
